question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**soon**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Soon** means **something that is about to happen after a short period**.

 
 
• Example - ***The bus will arrive soon.***
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, The Selection Board will be scheduled as soon as all affected Short Service Commission (SSC) women officers
